articles.title: Ghana's GMET Digital Assessment Highlights ICT, Cybersecurity and Data Gaps
articles.description: A digital maturity assessment is highlighting ICT, cybersecurity and data gaps at Ghana's Ghana Meteorological Agency as the institution works to modernise its digital infrastructure and improve service delivery.
articles.author: TechHub Ghana

articles.title: NITA Launches 2026 National ICT Week to Accelerate Digital Transformation
articles.description: Ghana's National Information Technology Agency has launched the 2026 National ICT Week celebration as part of efforts to promote digital transformation and strengthen the country's technology ecosystem.
articles.author: TechHub Ghana

articles.title: Ghana Technology Leader Launches Book on AI Governance and Cybersecurity
articles.description: A new publication explores artificial intelligence governance, cybersecurity, risk management and responsible AI as Ghana continues to expand discussions around safe and responsible technology adoption.
articles.author: TechHub Ghana

articles.title: Ghana Begins National AI Training Programme to Boost Public Sector Innovation
articles.description: Ghana has begun a national artificial intelligence training programme designed to help public-sector workers understand and responsibly use AI while considering issues such as privacy, cybersecurity, misinformation and algorithmic bias.
articles.author: TechHub Ghana

articles.title: Ghana Pushes Tech-Law Reforms to Support AI, FinTech and Cybersecurity Growth
articles.description: Ghana is working to strengthen technology-related regulatory frameworks covering fintech, e-commerce, data protection, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence.
articles.author: TechHub Ghana

articles.title: Digital Platform Supports Ghanaian MSMEs With Registration, Tax and Business Services
articles.description: A digital platform developed in coordination with the Ghana Revenue Authority is designed to give Ghanaian micro, small and medium-sized businesses access to registration, accounting, VAT payment, tax filing and compliance services.
articles.author: TechHub Ghana
